OUTPUT.description: Folder of gate.json and record.json when --out and --record are not given.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T05:00:00Z, for escalation and expiry. Default: the clock.

PORT.description: serve: the port the HTTP server listens on.

GATEKEEPER_OPA.description: The OPA 1.x program that evaluates the policy.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_ADAPTER.description: The command line of the channel port's slack adapter, which reaches Slack for a slack: channel (ADR 0062).

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_URL.description: Base URL of the Slack Web API, ending in a slash: the adapter's CHANNEL_API_URL. Default: the adapter's, https://slack.com/api/.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_TOKEN.description: Slack bot token with chat:write and channels:history: the adapter's CHANNEL_TOKEN. Required for a slack: channel.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: serve: the signing secret of the Slack app, the adapter's CHANNEL_SIGNING_SECRET, which checks every request from Slack. Required for serve.

GATEKEEPER_FORGE_ADAPTER.description: The command line of the forge port's adapter for --pull-request (ADR 0062). Default: npx -y @opensoftware/forge-github for github.com, npx -y @opensoftware/forge-forgejo for any other host.

GATEKEEPER_FORGE_URL.description: The forge adapter's FORGE_URL. Default: https://api.github.com for github.com, the pull request's origin for Forgejo.

GATEKEEPER_FORGE_TOKEN.description: The forge adapter's FORGE_TOKEN: a token that may read the pull request, comment on it and set its commit status. Never written to a file.

GATEKEEPER_SIGNING_KEY.description: Ed25519 private key in PEM that signs each record. Without it the record is unsigned.

GATEKEEPER_NATS_URL.description: NATS server, like nats://localhost:4222, for the events gate.requested@v1 and gate.decided@v1. Unset: no events. serve keeps them in its outbox while NATS is unreachable.

GATEKEEPER_DATABASE_URL.description: serve: the PostgreSQL database, like postgres://gatekeeper@db/gatekeeper, for the gates and the outbox. Required for serve.

GATEKEEPER_API_TOKEN.description: serve: the token that callers of the API send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Required for serve. Never written to a file.
